back: A plant growing where it is not wanted.
Compete for water, nutrients, light, space; parasitise; host pests and diseases; contaminate produce; poison livestock; raise costs.
Soil cover against erosion, organic matter, food and medicine, fodder, habitat for natural enemies.
Annual: one season, survives as seed (blackjack). Perennial: more than two years, regrows from rhizomes or tubers (couch grass, nut grass).
Grasses: round hollow stems, parallel veins. Sedges: solid triangular stems (nut grass). Broad-leaved: net veins (blackjack).
Maize, sorghum, millets and wild grasses; it parasitises roots and damages the crop before emerging.
By rhizomes and stolons; ploughing and hoeing cut and spread pieces that regrow.
Wind, water, animals (barbed seeds, manure), people and tools, contaminated seed, vegetative parts.
Mean count per quadrat ÷ quadrat area (m²) = weeds per m².
